_comment: Strict allow-list of the sites that may write to the stored events (refactor/design/0007-slice-events-api.md, step 0). `pytest refactor/tests/browser --dirty-writes-strict` fails a test whose write comes from a site not listed here. Matched on file, function, operation (set, delete, define, replace) and depth (0 frames, 1 one frame, 2 one observation, 3+ nested); the line and the field are not part of the key. Entries are removed as the steps of slice 4 move each writer behind Events; the end state is empty (annotation/Events.js writes to a private structure). `note` is for the reader only.
